title: Entering Vietnam plant-based dairy in two stages

title: Enter Vietnam through a co-manufacturer now and decide on a plant at month 24

points.lead: Vietnam is the fastest growing of five markets
bullets: It grows 14.2% a year to 2030 against 7.4% to 10.3% elsewhere

points.lead: The market is still open to a new brand
bullets: The top three brands hold 38% in Vietnam against 61% in Thailand

points.lead: Shoppers will pay for the product
bullets: 46% tried plant-based milk and accept an 18% premium

bullets: It breaks even in year 3 on $6M, against year 5 on $18M for an own plant

decision: Decision today: approve $6M for option B and a month-24 gate on the plant.

title: Vietnam is the smallest of the five markets after the Philippines

bullets.text: Thailand and Indonesia are larger but already concentrated

title: Vietnam sales will almost double to $408M by 2030

takeaway.text: Sales grow by $198M in five years, a 14.2% annual rate
